Freeze Spell

Author: artisticdude
Source: https://opengameart.org/content/freeze-spell-0
File: freeze.wav
Downloaded from: https://opengameart.org/sites/default/files/freeze.wav

License: CC0 (Creative Commons Zero / public domain)
https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

No attribution required. Originally created for the FOSS RPG "Summoning Wars," per the
OpenGameArt page.

---

2026-08-09 (issue #151): added freeze-trimmed.wav, a derivative of the file above (Art
Sourcing Contract step 3 -- recombine/derive an already-sourced CC0 asset, not a new
download). The original ran 2.125s and has multiple crackle swells rather than one clean
decay; the trimmed copy cuts at 1.20s, right at a natural low point between the first and
second swell (avoids chopping mid-crescendo), fading the last 60ms to zero. Same CC0 license
applies to the derivative. Original file kept alongside, untouched, as provenance.

2026-08-11 (issue #111): added freeze-normalized.wav, a derivative of the -trimmed file above
(Art Sourcing Contract step 3, same as the 2026-08-09 entry). RMS-normalized to -16 dBFS (from
-20.09 dBFS -- the quietest of the 4 per-element files pre-normalization) via a smooth
tanh soft-limiter (not a hard clip) so the needed +4.09dB gain doesn't distort the loudest
transients; length was already at the shared 1.20s target so no trim/pad was needed. Same CC0
license applies. Both earlier files kept alongside, untouched, as provenance. See
docs/agents/tilesmith/log.md's 2026-08-11 entry for the full before/after measurement table.
